title: release: --dry-run skips the read-only canon-spill check, so a dry run passes a tree the real run refuses
body:
`bin/devbin build release --dry-run` skips the canon-spill refusal: the block at `bin/.devbin/cmd/build.d/release:852` runs only when `DRY_RUN != true`. The check reads `intent claude upgrade` without `--apply`, which writes nothing, so a dry run could make it. As it is, a dry run passes a tree that the real run then refuses before stamping.

Fix: run the spill check in both modes. XS. vc's next-line list, item 3.


CLOSED 2026-09-19, by its landing in dc's train B on vc's word (bank 2b824b882, patch-id c5a663b1b0c2, judged green on the train's bats log refs/bank/dc/trainB/bats.log: every arm green on the fixed script and the new arm red on the unfixed one).
